content: sse-starlette v3.4.4 (May 2026): EventSourceResponse sends pings every 15s by default (customizable via ping= param), supports disconnect detection via await request.is_disconnected() polled in the generator loop, or by catching asyncio.CancelledError when the stream is forcibly cancelled. For broadcasting one snapshot to many concurrent clients (Innkeeper's single global SSE channel, D-13), the standard pattern is a shared asyncio.Queue or pub-sub broker per connection fed by a single background task that polls/aggregates state and pushes into each subscriber's queue — not one query-the-DB-per-client-per-tick design.
